subject: Fluxlytics trial — gateways, access & credentialing roadmap
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sierra Novak <sierra.novak@fluxlytics.com>; Adam Patel <adam@fluxlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fluxlytics trial — proposed gate plan & access items

Hi Sierra / Adam —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for walking through the primary production use case. Per our call, I sketched a short, pragmatic trial plan to validate the two goals you flagged: (1) latency and throughput on 1k concurrent sessions, and (2) semantic recall for 6 months of historical chat.

Attached: Fluxlytics_POC_Roadmap_v1.xlsx — draft timeline, owner map, and test cases. High-level proposal below: 

- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week baseline + 2-week stress & edge cases)
- Success criteria (examples):
  * p95 latency <= 300ms for 1k concurrent live sessions (50-token average)
  * Embedding recall F1 >= 0.78 on curated prompt set
  * No data egress outside your VPC region / logs retained per your retention policy
- Ownership: Redwood will provide a single technical lead (Marissa) for onboarding and a sandbox API key; Fluxlytics will provide an internal test owner and an SSO admin who can invite users.
- Access asks from our side: SSO invitation for 3 users + IP allowlist CIDR(s) for the sandbox (if you prefer IP-based controls).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm success criteria above (or paste your acceptance matrix into the XLSX).
2) Approve SSO invite for marissa.cole@redwood.com and ben.carter@redwood.com (or share an alternate onboarding account).
3) Share IP ranges to add to our ephemeral allowlist, or we will provide temporary API key and warn you to rotate after the trial.

If that sounds right I can send the onboarding checklist and a sandbox key by EOD.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Fluxlytics_POC_Roadmap_v1.xlsx
From: Sierra Novak <sierra.novak@fluxlytics.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fluxlytics trial — proposed gate plan & access items

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- The success criteria look reasonable; we'll confirm the exact embedding dataset (we have a 2k-row canonical set). I will ask our data lead to annotate a 200-item eval set for week 1.
- SSO: yes, we use Okta. I can send an invite to marissa.cole@redwood.com and ben.carter@redwood.com; we also need to add one internal observer (qa@fluxlytics.com).
- IP allowlist: we prefer Okta + IP. Our infra team will provide a short list of CIDRs by EOD Thursday.

Two asks for Redwood: can you provide a short-lived sandbox API key and a minimal onboarding doc (SSO steps + token rotation guidance)? Also — is there an embedded examples notebook we can run against our dataset?

If you can deliver the key and checklist today, we can kickoff onboarding on Monday.

Best,
Sierra Novak
Head of Product | Fluxlytics
Sierra.Novak@fluxlytics.com
